reason: The company secured a SAR 185.9 million contract to build AI-focused data center infrastructure, providing a direct revenue boost and validating its position in the regional AI infrastructure build-out.
why_now: The contract award was officially announced on November 1, 2026.
source_headlines: Etihad GO Telecom Co. (GO) announces the award of a project to Total Technical Triangle Company - 3T, valued at SAR 185.9 million, for the supply and installation of infrastructure for a data center dedicated to artificial intelligence (AI) and advanced computing using NVIDIA processors.
